title: Did One Person Build the Biggest Vibe-Coded Project?
description:
One person built this. The live project map reports roughly 2,000 files and more than 500,000 lines, all connected inside one working desktop application.

Is there a bigger project built entirely through AI-directed development by a solo creator? If there is, I genuinely want to see it.

The project shown is Valo: https://getvalo.dev
